# ADR 0002: Candidate generation in PostgreSQL, scoring in Java

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Sanctions screening service

## Context

Scoring every list entry per request is too slow; SQL alone can't express the full scoring logic.

## Decision

Use a pg_trgm GIN index to fetch a small candidate set, then score with Jaro-Winkler and token-set similarity in Java.

## Consequences

Millisecond screening with explainable scores.

## Alternatives considered

Brute-force scoring; a search engine cluster.
